creator: griffybit
statement: Video explains how to get Catching Coordination and Threading the Needle achievements and the optimal catching minigame setup.

creator: griffybit
statement: Best tip: play in the up-down area because the dark background and cherry fly give a nice red dot to track.

creator: griffybit
statement: Play on a non-congested server to reduce lag spikes that could kill you.

creator: griffybit
statement: Move from congested lava 14 to lava 5 for far fewer lag spikes.

creator: griffybit
statement: Catching Coordination requires a high score of 128 in the catching minigame.

creator: griffybit
statement: Threading the Needle requires passing through the tiny lava loops in catching; it only appears after 20 hoops in a row.

creator: griffybit
statement: For the 128 achievement go only for bronze and green hoops.

creator: griffybit
statement: Do not go for gold hoops; they are far too risky.

creator: griffybit
statement: Hit hoops coming from the bottom rather than descending from the top; coming from the top is less accurate for smaller hoops.

creator: griffybit
statement: Line up with the bottom of the hoop or just below it so clicking up is easier; helps with lava and gold hoops.

creator: griffybit
statement: Don't attempt it on mobile; weaker than PC or Steam so lag spikes are worse and phone tapping is less precise.

creator: griffybit
statement: If two hoops are too close together they count as only one point so avoid double hoops.

creator: griffybit
statement: Going for double hoops does not give double points so it isn't worth it.

creator: griffybit
statement: Attempt Threading the Needle at the beginning since the slower speed makes lining up with the lava loop easier.

creator: griffybit
statement: Line up slightly lower than the hoop

creator: griffybit
statement: He has about a 20 percent success rate getting through the lava hoop; it is a huge pain.

creator: griffybit
statement: The 20 hoops in a row include bronze green and gold loops and possible double loops; with luck you can skip gold loops.

creator: griffybit
statement: Threading the Needle mostly takes practice.

creator: griffybit
statement: Recap: pick the area that suits you (he prefers up-down) and a non-congested server.

creator: griffybit
statement: Do the two achievements in separate runs; don't try to get both in one run.

creator: griffybit
statement: For the achievement go only bronze and green hoops and approach from the bottom or parallel/just below the hoop.

creator: griffybit
statement: Attempt it on PC unless that's not an option; double hoops only count as one point.
